highlights: Set which members can use the browser in a channel, and see their tabs and the channel's files in the side panel.
Right-click the Dynamic Island or the agent dock to hide it, drag agents on the dock to move them, and change the dock size.
A chat that you read no longer stays in the Unread group, and you can turn the group off.
A Claude chat that got too long now starts a new session with its history, and an agent moves to its backup model at the 5-hour limit.
New versions now go to about 1 in 10 computers first, and to all computers about one day later.
